entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer and planeswalker from Kaladesh who builds the Temporal Anchor, traps a sabotaging spirit, and recalls being forced to repair Gonti's aether heart.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who extends her ghostform over the anchor's coffin and fights the spirit Sharaman.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A planeswalker and archmage, descendant of Urza, who reads Thran script and discovers Urza's pocket dimension.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who plans to travel back in time inside the Temporal Anchor's coffin.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer and old friend of Jodah, who talks with him through a cloud of shimmering mercury.

entities.name: Gonti
aliases: Gonti, lord of the Night Market
entities.description: An immortal aetherborn crime lord of Ghirapur with a failing aether heart, who coerces Saheeli into repairing it.

entities.name: Sharaman
entities.description: The spirit of the general who led Urza's armies, who sabotages the Temporal Anchor to prevent Urza's war machine from being restarted.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker artificer, builder of the tower, Teferi's teacher and Jodah's ancestor, who left behind the Starfield Orb and a pocket-dimension failsafe.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A construct in Urza's pocket dimension modeled on Urza's brother.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A construct in Urza's pocket dimension modeled on his companion; the real Xantcha's memories are in the golem Karn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The golem that contains everything the real Xantcha was.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's artificer whose illustrations appear in the book on the shelf.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Author of The Antiquities War.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A person Saheeli remembers fondly.

entities.name: Adeliz
entities.description: A friend to whom Jodah sends love.

entities.name: Aarav
entities.description: Saheeli's father.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: Saheeli's mother, whose bracelet Gonti holds.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker Jodah holds dear.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Saheeli's time machine that projects a person's spirit backward in time, powered by the Weatherlight's powerstone.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: One of Teferi's artifacts that receives the anchor's temporal energy.

entities.name: Starfield Orb
entities.description: A black crystal orb in a silver cage, made by Urza with soul energy and Thran script, that strengthens Sharaman's spirit.

entities.name: Aether heart
entities.description: The mechanical heart in Gonti's chest that pulls aether from the air and makes him immortal.

entities.name: The Antiquities War
entities.description: A book by Kayla bin-Kroog, with many editions on the shelf of Urza's pocket dimension.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: Urza's failsafe plan, schematics and lineage records for rebuilding his armies if he died before deploying them against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urza's tower
entities.description: The tower on Dominaria where the Coalition works.

entities.name: Urza's pocket dimension
entities.description: A hidden space made to look like Urza's cabin in the Ohran Mountains of Gulmany.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Kaladesh where Saheeli was raised and Gonti rules the underworld.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Saheeli's home plane.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Coalition is working.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders the Coalition is trying to stop.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers.

entities.name: Aetherborn
entities.description: A people on Kaladesh who read emotions as scents and were once hunted.

events.summary: Kaya extends her ghostform over the coffin while Saheeli powers up the Temporal Anchor in a test, but the circuitry fails in a shower of sparks.
events.quote: A shower of sparks poured out from a bank of circuitry

events.summary: Saheeli finds the wiring torn apart, and Kaya shields her from an explosion, with both sensing a melancholy presence hovering nearby.
events.quote: extending her ghostform to protect them both from the explosion

events.summary: Kaya identifies a black crystal orb from Teferi as the cause and wants to know why it creates ghosts.
events.quote: a black crystal orb encased in a cage of silver

events.summary: Flashback: Saheeli wakes tied to a chair in a room of stolen art as Gonti, who knows everything about her family, addresses her.
events.quote: she woke up tied to a chair in this place.

events.summary: Flashback: Gonti reveals their cracked-stone chest and failing aether heart and demands Saheeli repair it.
events.quote: It has begun to fail.

events.summary: Flashback: Gonti threatens to have Saheeli's family executed, starting with her mother, and shows her mother's bracelet.
events.quote: If I don't send word in the allotted time, their instructions are to execute everyone.

events.summary: Saheeli and Kaya find Jodah speaking with Jhoira, who asks if Teferi is still bent on going back in time.
events.quote: He's still bent on going back?

events.summary: Kaya explains the orb is strengthening a lingering spirit through a silver cord of psychic energy.
events.quote: I saw a silver cord extending from the orb to the spirit.

events.summary: Jodah recognizes Urza's work in the orb and reveals Urza was the tower's builder, Teferi's teacher and his ancestor.
events.quote: Teferi's teacher. And my ancestor.

events.summary: Jodah reveals Thran script in the orb's cage reading, Go back to the beginning and greet me properly.
events.quote: It's the written language of the Thran, an ancient civilization on this plane,

events.summary: Flashback: Saheeli repairs Gonti's cracked silver filament, learning Gonti is immortal, and Gonti reveals the threat was a test of faith.
events.quote: A small fracture in the filament had developed over time

events.summary: Saheeli and Kaya spring a trap that gives the spirit a semblance of solidity using the rhythm of Gonti's heart.
events.quote: Saheeli's trap worked!

events.summary: The spirit shoves Saheeli aside, hacks the anchor with a ghostly blade and flees; Kaya pursues.
events.quote: The blade struck the anchor, gouging a deep gash into its side.

events.summary: Saheeli and Jodah find Kaya facing the spirit, who gives his name as Sharaman, the leader of Urza's armies.
events.quote: General Sharaman,

events.summary: Sharaman says he acts to prevent Urza's war machine restarting and recounts losing his nephews to Mishra's dragon engines and the sacking of Sardia.
events.quote: I will not let anyone repeat the mistakes I made.

events.summary: Kaya lunges at Sharaman in her ghostform and kills him, then kneels shaken; he asked if he would see his family again and she said he would.
events.quote: she activated her ghostform and lunged at the spirit

events.summary: Saheeli begins the final run with Teferi in the coffin and Kaya in position.
events.quote: Saheeli switched on the anchor.

events.summary: Epilogue: Jodah casts a shock spell at the Starfield Orb and is pulled into a pocket dimension resembling Urza's cabin.
events.quote: In a blue flash, the world vanished

events.summary: Jodah meets constructs of Xantcha and Mishra, who accept him as a descendant of Urza.
events.quote: My name is Jodah, friend of Teferi's and descendant of Urza,

events.summary: Jodah realizes the place is Urza's failsafe, the Legacy, and plans to tell Teferi; Mishra relays Urza's final words about ending conflicts.
events.quote: This whole place—it's Urza's failsafe in case he perished before he could deploy it against the Phyrexians.

relations.note: Jodah is confident the orb is Urza's doing.
relations.quote: I have little doubt that this orb is his doing.

relations.note: Sharaman led Urza's armies and served faithfully for decades.
relations.quote: I served Urza faithfully for decades

relations.note: Sharaman attacks Saheeli's anchor to stop the Coalition.
relations.quote: If that means stopping you, I will do so.
He didn't give us much choice.

relations.note: Gonti coerces Saheeli by threatening her family.

relations.quote: their reign over Ghirapur's underworld had lasted well longer than an aetherborn's lifespan

relations.note: Saheeli built and repeatedly tested the anchor.
relations.quote: Saheeli had lost count of how many times she'd tested the Temporal Anchor

relations.note: Close friends who speak by mercury cloud.
relations.quote: You two are so alike. It's annoying.

relations.note: The real Xantcha was Urza's companion.

relations.quote: The Antiquities War by Kayla bin-Kroog,
